sources.label: Verified StakedUSDeV2 cooldown and silo source

reserveReview.rationale: Ethena documents proportional USDe share redemption. At Ethereum block 26114890 (2026-10-03), asset() is USDe, cooldownDuration() is 86400 seconds and totalAssets plus unvested rewards reconciles exactly to the vault's USDe balance. cooldownShares burns shares and transfers their USDe to the immutable silo; unstake releases those assets after the recorded cooldown. The one-day liquidity classification describes current native USDe realization for unrestricted holders, not dollar sale or guaranteed future policy: administrators may change future-request cooldowns up to 90 days and blacklist powers remain. The historic composition date and 100% parent dependency are unchanged.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Ethena sUSDe staking documentation and the exact live ERC-4626 single-asset row
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: sUSDe has no independent reserve portfolio; upstream USDe hedge collateral, custody, and counterparty allocation are tracked on the parent asset.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Sol curation pass 2026-10-01 (RuleC26), D08 direct-wrapper custody review
custodyProfile.uncertainty: The onchain custodyModel describes direct wrapper custody of USDe in the staking vault and withdrawal silo, as documented by Ethena and confirmed by asset() at Ethereum block 26097118 on 2026-10-01. Upstream USDe collateral providers, hedge counterparties and their allocations remain in the usde-ethena parent dependency. This wrapper review does not establish their safeguards, legal segregation or bankruptcy treatment, and does not remove inherited parent risk. No provider share is estimated.
